content:
Alex: heads-up — since ~09:30 we've been seeing a pile of multi-GPU training pods stuck Pending in eu-west1-b while eu-west1-a has a bunch of spare GPUs. gang-scheduled jobs get preempted when they finally land. :warning:
Priya: saw that too, around 09:28-09:40. autoscaler didn't add capacity in b even though CPU/GPU util > 95% for a few minutes.
Sam: grabbing some kubectl output now, snippet:
```
NAME                      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
trainer-large-0           0/4     Pending   0          7m
Events:
  0/5 nodes are available: 5 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
```
Priya: looks like AZ-local nodepools are unbalanced. scale-down window drifted after the last deploy so a bunch of small jobs packed into a few nodes in a, leaving fragmented capacity in b.
Jordan: autoscaler-bot log shows scale-up suppressed due to "recent-scale" throttle and a mis-set balancing threshold. autoscaler is zonal so it won't rebalance across AZs by itself.
autoscaler-bot: [09:36] scale-up suppressed for group-eu-west1-b: recent-scale-up; next-eval in 5m.
Tina: cost concern — we can add buffer, but that will enlarge committed spend. before adding capacity we should try scheduling tweaks to improve binpacking density.
Alex: tried tainting low-priority pods out of b to free GPUs, but that triggered eviction churn and made the scheduler thrash — not great for training jobs.
Priya: immediate mitigation plan I propose:
- bump autoscaler cooldown to allow cross-zone launches (temporary)
- enable binpack-affinity for gpu workloads (prefer colocation of similar-size pods)
- lower scale-up suppression for group-eu-west1-b for the next 30m
Sam: quick commands to run if oncall agrees:
```bash
# allow scale-up override for 30m
kubectl annotate cm cluster-autoscaler config --overwrite \"scaleOverride=group-eu-west1-b:override:30m\"
# enable binpack policy (canary)
kubectl apply -f /configs/gpu-binpack-canary.yaml -n kube-system
```
Jordan: I'll push the canary to staging first and watch the allocation patterns. if all good, roll to prod in 15m.
Tina: please add a temporary billing alert for projected +$5k/day if we keep spinning extra nodes. we need the finance window to ok any autoscale-for-capacity step.
Priya: on it — adding alert and the runbook link in a sec: https://go/redwood/runbooks/gpu-az-imbalance
Alex: thanks — @Jordan @Sam can you coordinate the staging canary? I'll coordinate with SRE to run the override if canary looks stable.
Jordan: will do. ping me when you want the prod rollout, I'll be available for the next 90m. :thumbsup:
Sam: consolidating logs and will paste pod/eviction counts in 10m.
autoscaler-bot: [09:49] note: group-eu-west1-b scaled up by 1 due to manual override request.
Priya: closing loop: once jobs drain, we should revisit the autoscaler zone-balancing thresholds and add a small gating test in pre-merge to catch aggressive scale-down config changes.
Tina: agree. also add a cost tag to any temporary nodes so we can identify them in reports.
Alex: good plan. posting status into the incident channel if things go sideways.
